Scientific Instruments Change - LaHave Bank
Wave Glider C34167NS is transiting from 42 21.000N 065 12.500W along the following coordinates in sequence:
42 28.000N 065 00.630W
 42 48.180N 064 17.022W
 43 03.360N 063 47.280W
 43 18.960N 063 31.075W
Wave glider c34164NS is copper in colour with a mast extending 1.2 metres above the surface of the water, supporting a solid white light and orange visibility flag and is equipped with a non-transmitting AIS receiver.
It is remotely operated, moving at a speed of approximately 1.0 knots and measuring 3.05 metres by 0.81 metres.
For further information, authorities and mariners may contact Sue L’Orsa at 250-877-8052, Tyler Byrne 902-719-7078, or Liquid Robotics Wave Glider Operations Centre at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-4205
